title: pm-dispatch: SKILL.md principle-only (815 → 319 lines) — dispatch / review / landing detail relocated into per-phase references, core-rules.md retired
body:
Fixes #19716

Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:PM 协议主文 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 从 815 行压到 319 行,只留原则——红线、优先级、入口与角色(含参数表)、新增的「阶段细则索引」表、全体座位的不变量、状态模型、域车道、受管面的「路径分叉」块、升级与决策(含四轴框架单源)、报告契约、机械守卫索引、模板与表。派发 / 分诊 / 座位生命周期 / 读数纪律 / 多仓协调 / 入队与落地的细则逐字搬进六份按阶段读的 references(五份新建:`seat-lifecycle.md`、`reading-discipline.md`、`cross-repo-coordination.md`、`triage-duties.md`、`execution-duties.md`;既有的 `landing-operations.md` 吸收「入队与落地」),每份第一行写明哪个座位在哪个 fire 读它。`references/core-rules.md`(SKILL.md 的人读摘要副本,151 行)删除,所有指向它和被搬章节的指针重定向。行数棘轮把 SKILL.md 上限从 819 降到 319,新文件按落地行数入表,棘轮总量下降。

**为什么改**:决策批 #213 第 4 项,维护者原话「1 2 4 同意」,项目原文「协议主文 819 → 约 300 行(红线 + 状态模型 + 入口 + 索引),派发 / 复核 / 入队细则各成一份按阶段读的 reference;同时删 core-rules.md 双份」。目的是每个座位每次 fire 只读本阶段的文件,不再整本重读 815 行外加 151 行的副本。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯搬迁,无语义变化——被搬的 465 条规则行里 459 条逐字相同,5 条只改了指针拼写(指向新家),1 条自指指针删除;「⛔」行数搬前搬后相等(对合并基点 558 对 558,对派发基点 559 对 559;都不计被删副本自带的 59 行)。代价落在指针:部分 references 的指针行受 120 字节行宽与零余量约束,只写文件名不写章节名(章节标题在新文件里原样保留);两个门禁脚本各改了一处指向路径(自测通过)。SKILL.md 落在 319 行——高于「约 300」但低于 340 上限——多出的部分是 `check:pm-governed-prose` 锚定在 SKILL.md 里的受管面路径分叉块(28 行)加索引表(11 行)。回滚 = revert 本 PR(一个 squash commit);棘轮上限已降,回滚时抬回需维护者裁决引用。

**席位意见**:(席位填写)

**你要做的**:本 PR 属 Tier S(路径全在 `.claude/**` 与 `scripts/pm/**`),由 skills 席在席内契约复审 PASS 后走队列落地,不需要你点击。若对新文件命名、或 SKILL.md 保留 319 行而非约 300 行有异议,在本 PR 评论一句即可。

## What this PR does

Relocation, not deletion — decision batch #213 item 4 (maintainer, verbatim: 「1 2 4 同意」). Every rule line of `SKILL.md` on the base (`fae870352`, 815 lines) ends up in exactly one place: `SKILL.md` if it is principle, otherwise one per-phase reference. `references/core-rules.md` (the declared subset / human digest, 151 lines) is deleted. No rule added, no rule dropped, no gate / hook / ratchet / roster added; `os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `skills/**` untouched.

Six destination files, one commit each (the branch is bisectable by destination):

| destination | opens with (which seat reads it on which fire) | lines |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `references/execution-duties.md` (new) | 执行席每次 fire 读本文:候选、认领、派发、收集、复核;落地窗口另读 `landing-operations.md`。 | 183 |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (new) | 每个座位每次 fire 读本文:开轮互斥读数之前读〈开轮互斥〉,收班之前读其余各节。 | 96 |
| `references/triage-duties.md` (new) | 分诊席每次 fire 开局读本文;本文是分诊座位的全部职责。 | 120 |
| `references/reading-discipline.md` (new) | 任一座位在取读数、引读数或核验 main 的那一刻读本文,所有 fire、所有阶段。 | 37 |
| `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` (new) | 分诊席每次 fire 路由与查重前读本文;执行席跨仓认领、派发或转移时读本文。 | 51 |
| `references/landing-operations.md` (existing, absorbs 入队与落地) | 执行席在落地窗口(ACCEPT 之后至 MERGED)读本文;入队与落地条款与 A–D 操作细则都在此。 | 69 → 101 |

Why two files beyond the card's suggested shape: 平台读数纪律 and 多仓协调 are read by BOTH seats (readings are taken on every fire; cross-repo routing is triage's, cross-repo claiming/dispatch is execution's). Folding either into one seat's phase file would make the other seat skip it — a rule dropped in effect — and keeping both in `SKILL.md` lands it at 367 lines, over the 340 ceiling. Each gets a single-section file whose title is the section heading, so every 〈heading〉 pointer still resolves.

## Proof: relocation, not deletion

Measured by an independent verifier over the working tree against `git show de4ed33fd:…` (the merge base; script in the report):

- Moved content lines (non-blank, non-heading, in the spans above): **465** — **459 verbatim**, **5 rewritten** (pointer retargets inside moved text, listed below), **1 dropped** (644, the self-pointer), **0 missing**.
- Retained `SKILL.md` lines: **302 / 302** present in their original order (the three rewritten and the one dropped 优先级 line excepted, listed below).
- 「⛔」 lines, against the PR's merge base `de4ed33fd`: before **617** (`SKILL.md` 194 + `references/**` 423, of which `core-rules.md` 59) — after **558** (`SKILL.md` 68 + `references/**` 490). Excluding the deleted duplicate's own 59 lines: **558 == 558**. (Against the dispatch base `fae870352` the same proof reads 618 → 559, the one-line difference being #19795's edit to `seat-post-protocol.md`, merged in.)
- Decision frame block: byte-identical, only its line position changed (`check:skill-frame-sync` and `-freshness` green).
